axes.interpretation_limit: Known budget effects are prior art. A larger requested cap is neither an uncensored detector nor proof that above-threshold outputs differ. Delta M/W alone is not a mechanism or promotion trigger. Source and target certificate scopes cannot be conflated.

axes.early_stop: If development replay establishes the joint source/target certificate null for an axis/objective, report the tested development contrast null and stop it before ACDC compute. Negligible unknown exposure with no boundary/material operating effect may justify deprioritization, not a universal zero-effect claim.

axes.interpretation_limit: Inactive exporter floor does not imply absence of earlier head censoring. Completeness at t=f differs for > and >= acquisition. Delta M/W alone is not a mechanism or promotion trigger. Source and target certificate scopes cannot be conflated.

minimal_run_list.work: Prepared plan only: 32 deterministic KITTI images x 4 systems at baseline; no target GT tuning or current execution authorization.
When coordinated, two actual native lower-policy checks from development_pilot.json per system; conservatively all 32 images per policy/system. No current GPU permission.
Six OAT policy settings x 4 systems x 4 threshold objectives, each common-threshold and reselected contrast. One maximal acquisition per system/population where reuse valid.

At baseline/rho .90, global s-squared with observed reselection and same numeric cutoff (8 additional evaluations); mapped-boundary equality is checked in the same control. Baseline clipping x 4 systems x 4 objectives (16 evaluations).
Only after a core mechanism survives: class-order baseline per system; NMS .5/.9 on YOLO26 O2M; separate population thresholds; warning baseline comparison. No Cartesian combinations.
Repeat the smallest informative contrast at seeds 17/42/73 before DEIM or more model families; requires separate training/compute assignment.

cache_reuse_requirements: Stable IDs from primitive anchor or query plus class before selection; fresh row numbers are not sufficient.
Observed-boundary scores and ties retained without rounding; compare multisets if native ID metadata is absent and report identity-level proof unavailable.
Document every selector and truncation, strictness, class order, realized head k and max_nms; finite output count alone proves nothing.
Prove deterministic hard-NMS prefix consistency for any before-NMS floor/cap replay, with fixed boxes/class/ties and no timeout; score-changing or learned suppression requires separate reasoning.
Check actual native lower-budget output on development data, including tie handling; an empirical replay match alone is not a universal selector proof.
When a required tensor or bound is absent, mark the replay/certificate unsupported or unknown; do not silently approximate.
A fixed native finite query pool is a reference pool, never proof that all real objects are represented.

algebraic_null.fixed_threshold: On a certified image, TP/FP/recall stay fixed and candidate-policy changes to M and W cancel. Transfer loss stays fixed when reference and target panels are certified at the same threshold.
algebraic_null.source_reselection: If every source-selection image is certified at the maximal-policy boundary, highest-observed-boundary reselection is unchanged under the fixed-pool/selector assumptions.
algebraic_null.source_target_distinction: Source certificate failure can move the threshold and alter recall even on a target image certified at both boundaries. Separate direct target candidate changes from source-induced reselection.
algebraic_null.unknown: A failed sufficient certificate is UNKNOWN, not demonstrated incompleteness. Low image exposure alone is not a bound because source boundary leverage and GT concentration can be large.
